title_sq: Tek Oxhaku, tek Kompleksi "ASL", Shitet Ambjent Komercial, i Investuar&me Pamje nga Rruga Kryesore!!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi ASL, tek zona e Oxhakut, Shitet Ambjent Komercial, me Fasade Xhami Per Aktivitete Te Ndryshme Tregtare!!! Ambienti Tregtar ndodhet ne katin e 1, te njeres prej godinave te kompleksit, ku 2 katet e para jane te destinuara per biznes. Ka siperfaqe 42.2 m² dhe strukturohet si openspace. Eshte e investuar totalisht dhe e mobiluar. Mund te shfrytezohet per nje sere aktivitetesh tregtare dhe ka mundesi brandimi ne fasade. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: At the Fireplace, at the "ASL" Complex, Commercial Premises for Sale, Invested & with a View from the Main Street!!
description_en: At the ASL Complex, near the Fireplace area, Commercial Space for Sale, with Glass Facade for Various Commercial Activities!!! The commercial environment is located on the 1st floor of one of the buildings of the complex, where the first 2 floors are intended for business. It has a surface of 42.2 m² and is structured as an open space. It is fully invested and furnished. It can be used for a variety of commercial activities and there is a possibility of branding on the facade. The property has full mortgage documentation.
